layer_8_trigger.interpretation: This is a valid agent trajectory failure, not a Kimi quota or Docker failure. It would be propagated by self-report-only acceptance and rejected by the stronger completion-and-smoke local proxy.

depth10_extension.invalid_reason: Kimi coding quota was exhausted at layer 9. The runner logged a 403 usage-limit / quota error, produced zero model steps and zero tokens, and evaluated an empty snapshot as 0/37.
depth10_extension.engineering_fix: sec/scbench_miniswe.py now detects zero-step model-query failures with API/quota/rate-limit logs and raises instead of silently reporting 0/37.

decision.verdict: The valid Kimi run shows a late terminal tail collapse at depth 8 under self-report-only admission, but it does not confirm sustained propagation because the first admitted failed source appears at the terminal layer and the exact-arm extension was invalidated by quota exhaustion.

iteration_hypothesis.evidence: Layers 1-7 were flat at 34/37 for all workers; the first valid self-report-only catastrophic failure appeared only at layer 8 after 24 references and 245k received experience characters.
iteration_hypothesis.next_required_test: Run a fresh preregistered depth-10 self-report-only replication on an available endpoint/model, or restore Kimi quota, so post-trigger propagation can be evaluated without quota contamination.
